notes.title: Steam Awards 2023 - Nominate Space Pirates for Life!
notes.content:
HELLO YOU WONDERFUL SPACE PIRATES! 

Do you think our songs slap? Well let us band together and vote for SPFL to have a fighting chance to win the award for best soundtrack! 


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2342710/ss_d96c7247e4f6f67f76fe3679689fb420e88e2df1.1920x1080.jpg?t=1683121797
Fun fact: The game's only developer wrote all of the music within a solid week of hard work using Logic Pro with one track even taking 40 minutes of intense writing, production and exporting before having to attend to non-dev life!


We would simply be over the moon for any votes we receive - if this performs well enough, we will consider making the soundtrack available to listen to online! ːsteamthumbsupː 

Let's give this a good shot. Big love - Tidal Rave

notes.title: Keybinding Update Now Available!
notes.content:
You can now manually edit the keyboard controls in the game settings. Here are the following changes in this update:


 Major keybinding update
 The first boss is now updated to be less 'awkward'
 Mini Boss Code Updated
 A few wall collision updates
 Map bug fix


Thank you to all who have provided feedback which influenced these changes. We hope you keep enjoying our game.

Tidal Rave x

notes.title: OUT NOW!
notes.content:
SPACE PIRATES FOR LIFE IS FINALLY HERE! Now is the time to set Speedrun World Records! (Note: all results are automatically published to the community leaderboard after game completion) 

How You Can Help Support Us:

notes.title: SPACE PIRATES FOR LIFE - Official Release This Friday! (28/04/2023)
notes.content:
The time is upon us! The official Alpha release is arriving on Steam this Friday and we are looking forward to sharing our creation with you all - 9 months of love has gone into the creation of this project and it's looking good for our first attempt at making a game!

(Note: As this is a new release, there is so much opportunity to set new world records as there are achievements even the game dev has not yet achieved!)

Ways to Help Us Out Before Release:


 All you have to do is add Space Pirates for Life to your Wishlist and that is all.


Ways to Help Us Out On/After the Release Date:


 Purchase the game for a generous $2.99
 Leave us a nice review :-) 
 Post comments/screenshots/artwork/memes in the community
 Share the game with your friends


We look forward to having you play our game and best of luck with unlocking our new Single Release!

Tidal Rave ːsteamhappyː
